name: Radon Group Partner Locator
author: infratech007

sections.description:
Radon Group Partner Locator supports partner contact details, featured image logos, latitude and longitude, marker customization, country filters, partner-level visible fields, CSV import/export, and custom image maps.

The plugin bundles its own map renderer and loads map tile images from OpenStreetMap or CARTO. Tile providers receive visitors’ IP addresses and are subject to their own terms and privacy policies. No external JavaScript or CSS is loaded.

Source Code

The human-readable JavaScript source is distributed in assets/app.js and assets/admin.js. No build or minification step is needed. The CSS source is assets/style.css. All these files are included in this plugin ZIP. Map tile images are retrieved from OpenStreetMap or CARTO, as explained above.

1.3.0

  • Renamed to Radon Group Partner Locator.
  • Namespaced global identifiers using radongpl prefix and migrated legacy settings, post types and metadata.
  • Retained the legacy shortcode.
  • Moved map-image media selector JavaScript into enqueued admin asset.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ZIP in Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Radon Group Partner Locator.
  3. Add partners in Partner Locator > All Partners; use the title for company name and featured image for the logo.
  4. Enter latitude and longitude in each partner’s details.
  5. Configure Partner Locator > Map Settings.
  6. Use [wp_partner_locator] in a WordPress Shortcode block or Elementor Shortcode widget.
sections.faq:
What is the shortcode?

Use [radongpl_locator] or the backward-compatible [wp_partner_locator]. Optional examples: [wp_partner_locator country=”India” height=”500″] and [wp_partner_locator mode=”image”].

Does it require a Google Maps API key?

No. It uses a locally bundled map renderer with OpenStreetMap/CARTO tile images.
sections.changelog:
1.3.1

  • Fixed partner form field-name mismatch that erased contact information and map coordinates when saving.
  • Prevented missing or invalid form data from overwriting saved partner details.
  • Preserved existing post types, options, partner metadata, and legacy shortcode compatibility.

1.1.3

Removed externally hosted scripts and styles, aligned text domain, updated headers and CSV file handling.

1.1.2

  • Declared GPLv2-or-later license in plugin header and readme.txt.
  • Added WordPress-standard readme.txt metadata.

1.1.1

  • Renamed the plugin to Radon Group Partner Locator.
